title: InspectorPanel — full-width parameter editor for selected band
description:
Implement the bottom full-width band inspector so every essential per-band parameter is editable without hidden context menus, per SHREDEQ_SPEC.md §13.5.

STRICT FILE SCOPE: Create or modify ONLY the files listed in this task's allowed_write_paths.

Before editing, inspect:
- .abracapocus/SHREDEQ_SPEC.md §13.5 bottom inspector parameter list
- Source/ParameterIDs.h for band-scoped frequency/gain/Q/type/slope/stage/routing/dynamics/detector/tracking/solo/bypass IDs
- Source/UI/ShredEQLookAndFeel.* for control styling from j.1
- JUCE AudioProcessorValueTreeState SliderAttachment / ComboBoxAttachment / ButtonAttachment patterns

Implement Source/UI/InspectorPanel.h and Source/UI/InspectorPanel.cpp:
1. juce::Component full-width strip intended for editor bottom docking.
2. On setSelectedBand(int index) rebuild or reattach controls for that band’s parameters via APVTS (constructor takes juce::AudioProcessorValueTreeState&).
3. Controls covering: frequency, gain, Q, filter type, slope, stage, routing (stereo/L/R/M/S as modeled by ParameterIDs), dynamic mode, threshold, range, attack, hold, release, knee, detector source, detector filter, tracking enable/source, solo, bypass.
4. Double-click numeric readout / label fields support juce::Label edit for numerical entry where practical.
5. Empty/no-selection state shows a muted placeholder; no crash on band index out of range (clamp or clear attachments).
6. Layout: horizontal or wrapping grid readable at min editor width ~980; do not require popup menus for essential parameters.
7. Optional solo headphone / delta (hear removed) buttons if ParameterIDs exist; otherwise expose callbacks.

Do not implement EQWorkspace graph, IntelligenceDrawer modules, PluginEditor assembly, or CMakeLists.txt.
acceptance_criteria: InspectorPanel constructs with juce::AudioProcessorValueTreeState reference and setSelectedBand(int) API
Inspector exposes controls for frequency, gain, Q, type, slope, stage, routing, dynamics (mode/threshold/range/attack/hold/release/knee), detector source/filter, tracking, solo, and bypass
Essential band parameters are editable from the inspector without requiring a context menu
Numerical entry is supported via editable labels or equivalent double-click value entry for primary continuous params
No file outside the task's allowed_write_paths is created or modified
forbidden_changes: hide essential band parameters exclusively behind popup menus

allowed: wrapping FlexBox/Grid layout for narrow widths
forbidden: own global header or view-mode switching
